description: Terms the OPLS-AA 2024 BOSS files (J. Phys. Chem. B 128, 250 (2024), SI) lack for polymers of CAPS's library, each from the OPLS-AA paper that defines it, and atom types (caps_*) for environments the table has no number for, charged by OPLS-AA's own group increments; bench/ff/convert_boss_opls.py --supplement adds them only where the .sb has no entry (Jorgensen's files win). Units as the .sb: K in kcal/mol/A^2 or /rad^2 (E = K (x - x0)^2), r0 in A, theta0 in degrees.
